issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Lecture differs between the problem statement (UML) and the solution reference. The problem statement instructs students to follow the UML attribute order when writing the constructor: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The solution repository defines the constructor with a different parameter order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents) (signature at solution file). This mismatch is likely to confuse students about the expected constructor signature and may cause inconsistencies between student implementations, example code, and any automated checks that expect the UML order.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML and the problem statement. Either: (A) change the solution constructor signature to match the UML order, e.g. public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly; or (B) if the solution order is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to explicitly show that constructor parameter order so students are not misled.
